$Comment: Feeding a station. The Target is the item id and the amount is the stack's quantity, counted the moment a station consumes it: a piece a ritual takes apart, a material a work cycle drains from the pile, a reagent an enhancement spends. Every consuming path counts once, when the consumption is final; an interrupted ritual hands its piece back and counts nothing. The Qualifier is the station id ('sawmill' for this jar's mill); name one to count only that station's input, leave it off to count the same item at any station, or author QualifierMatchMode PREFIX to count a family of stations by their shared name. Work a station settles with nobody standing at it counts for nobody: progress belongs to a player who was there. The Icon is the picture a step gets when its target has none of its own; a step naming an item is drawn with that item.
